migration.name: 20260826054627_normalize_tax_period_components_and_deposit_schedule
migration.backfill: Every existing TaxObligationPeriod.salesTaxAmount and inputTaxAmount is INSERTed as a sales_output / sales_input component row BEFORE the columns are dropped, so no filed or draft period loses its figures. Recorded zeros are carried rather than collapsed: a stored zero on an existing period is a stated fact ('nothing was charged'), unlike an absent row, and dropping it would silently reinterpret history. netTaxAmount is untouched, so no period's bottom line moves. TaxDepositSchedule is created empty — a cadence is a determination against a published threshold, and seeding one would fabricate the evidence a filing relies on.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Components are owned by their period and cascade-delete with it. They are replaced wholesale on each accrual run rather than merged, so a corrected run cannot leave a stale component asserting a liability the current facts no longer support.

fields.reason: Names which family of tax the total belongs to, so one period shape serves sales and payroll without either family's columns burdening the other (DI-31F2D7D10E25).
fields.provenance: Closed Prisma enum TaxPeriodComponentKind; a new tax family widens it by migration, never by string literal.

fields.reason: The component total that rolls into the period's net. Replaces the dropped salesTaxAmount and inputTaxAmount columns as the single home for a per-family figure.
fields.provenance: Derived from TaxLiabilityEntry drafts for sales tax, and from the payroll tax emitter's per-side summary for payroll. Rounded to cents at the write boundary.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Effective-dated and never edited in place: a determination made for one lookback year stays readable after the next replaces it, because it is the evidence for why a past deposit was timed as it was. Carries RecordLifecycle for withdrawal without deletion.

fields.reason: How often a determined deposit obligation falls due. Depositing on the wrong cadence produces late-deposit penalties even when every amount is correct.
fields.provenance: Determined by lookback against a published threshold; closed Prisma enum TaxDepositCadence.

fields.reason: The published figure the determination was made against, recorded rather than printed into source so it can be cited and superseded.
fields.provenance: Operator-supplied from the authority's publication, paired with sourceUrl. Never a constant in code (BI-4EB27955).

fields.reason: Without it the determination is unciteable, and an uncited figure must never drive a filing.
